Recruitment ran from 9 to 30 June 2023 through member email and social media, receiving 3,854 responses; around one tenth self-identified as industry workers. This was not a representative industry sample. The Google Drive appendix returned only Loading/Sign in; neither the appendix nor numerical values in images were checked. Line 87 reports 57% for self-identified animation workers and 75.5% for non-workers, not population estimates. Free-text comments at lines 93–98 are selected and interpreted by NAFCA; efficiency hopes coexist with concerns over training rights, motivation and international regulatory differences. description.en: The government draft proposes extending qualifying non-exclusive collective licences to non-mandating rightsholders with an ongoing right to object. Article 5 gives societies up to ten working days after an objection to end the relevant effect and notify users; Article 7 separately gives users up to ten working days after society notification to exclude works. Article 6 requires publicity but not individual notification. The two deadlines have different triggers.

Article6 requires publicity but not individual notification. The two deadlines have different triggers.

description.en: The Japan Actors Union welcomes the Ministry of Justice’s discussion of interpretative guidance on AI use of likenesses and voices. description.en: Clause 70 of SINDCINE/SIAESP’s Brazilian collective agreement accepts AI intended to improve and assist technical labour while committing to protect human creative labour. Its first paragraph protects creative copyright and prohibits reproduction of creators’ materials used by AI without their prior consent, including partial use or mixing with others’ works.
description.original: 巴西SINDCINE/SIAESP集体协议第70条接受旨在改善、协助技术劳动的AI，同时承诺保护人类创作劳动；其第一款要求保护创作版权，未经创作者事先同意不得复制AI使用的创作者材料，包括部分使用或与他人作品混合的情形。 / Clause70 accepts assistive AI while protecting creative labor and requiring prior consent for reproduction of creator material used by AI, including partial or mixed use.
description.zh: 巴西SINDCINE/SIAESP集体协议第70条接受旨在改善、协助技术劳动的AI，同时承诺保护人类创作劳动；其第一款要求保护创作版权，未经创作者事先同意不得复制AI使用的创作者材料，包括部分使用或与他人作品混合的情形。
material_description.en: A 51-page scanned PDF. Images of pages 1, 31, 39 and 40 were actually viewed; clause 70 on page 39 is the central evidence. Other pages were initially located only through thumbnails, not read in full. The cover is dated São Paulo, 21 August 2024, which supplies the document date, not a web publication or verified effective date. Scope, validity, signature/registration pages and implementation required further checking at that stage. The clause is not a ban on all AI, and its copying provisions are not expanded into an independently verified training-permission regime. The temporary PDF was used for reading; the archive retains metadata and links only, not a third-party document copy. The event uses the joint statement’s dateline, 29 August 2024; the webpage was published on 3 September 2024. The scanned agreement’s cover and page 46 bear 21 August 2024, differing from the statement’s signing date. Both are retained without an unsupported correction. Clause 81 gives 1 May 2024–30 April 2026 for general clauses and an end date of 30 April 2025 for economic clauses. These periods are not conflated with the statement’s claim of effectiveness or a registration date. Images of pages 6, 7, 46 and 47 were checked in this batch; page 47 shows names/signature images, not handwriting authentication or proof of government registration. Final registration and subsequent agreements remain unchecked.

description.en: The decision refuses the TOCIX artwork registration application (1-2023-88060), filed on 7 September 2023, inferring insufficient concrete human creative intervention from the applicant’s description of AI production. It is a DNDA administrative decision, not a final court judgment, new legislation or a review of all AI-assisted works. Pages 10–11 state notice, review and appeal procedures; actual notice, remedies and final status remain unchecked. On 17 October 2026, batch 808 rendered and read the remaining printed pages 4–8. Together with batch 807, this covers 11 substantive pages; physical page 12 is blank. Page 4 describes registration as declaratory and evidentiary rather than constitutive of rights; page 5 limits the registration function; pages 6–8 discuss human original expression and distinguish software tools from AI generation of specific expression. These are the authority’s 2023 reasons. Cited laws and cases were not separately obtained, and current law was not comprehensively checked. Page 4 records a digital-art classification and JPG attachment; the archive has not thereby obtained the artwork.
description.original: 决议拒绝2023-09-07提出的艺术作品TOCIX登记（1-2023-88060）；记录申请自述AI制作并据此推缺少具体人类创作介入。为DNDA行政决定，非法院终审、新立法或对所有AI辅助作品的个案审查。页10–11列通知及复议/上诉路径；未核通知日期、是否申请救济或最终状态。 / Refuses TOCIX application1-2023-88060 filed7 September2023, inferring insufficient concrete human creative intervention from its AI-production description. DNDA administrative decision, not final court judgment or new legislation. Notice/review/appeal route stated, actual notice, challenge and finality unverified. Batch808(2026-10-17)：已实际渲染并看完余下印刷pp4–8，连同807已读页现覆盖11页正文（第12物理页为空）。p4称登记为宣告/证明性质非权利创设，p5限定本次登记职能；pp6–8论人类原创表达并区分软件工具与AI生成具体表达。此为2023行政机关理由，所引法律/判例未另取原件，不推当前法律全面核查。p4记录数字艺术分类/JPG附件，不代表档案已取得原作品。 / Batch808 visually reads remaining printedpp4–8, completing11 substantive pages across two rounds. Reasons distinguish declaratory/evidentiary registration and human expression/tool use. These are the authority’s2023 reasons, not independent review of every cited law/case or current law. JPG attachment is recorded, not obtained.
description.zh: 决议拒绝2023年9月7日提出的TOCIX艺术作品登记申请（1-2023-88060），依据申请人自述AI制作推断缺少具体人类创作介入。这是DNDA行政决定，非法院终审、新立法或对所有AI辅助作品的审查。第10—11页列通知、复议及上诉路径；实际通知、救济及最终状态未核。批次808于2026年10月17日渲染并核读其余印刷页4—8，与批次807合计覆盖11页正文，第12物理页为空白。第4页将登记描述为宣告、证明性质而非创设权利，第5页限定此次登记职能，第6—8页讨论人类原创表达并区别软件工具与AI生成具体表达。这些是2023年行政机关的理由；所引法律和判例未另取原件，不代表现行法律全面核验。第4页提到数字艺术分类和JPG附件，不表示档案已取得原作品。

description.en: On 26 March 2026 EJI announced an agreement to purchase usage rights for Deezer’s AI detection tool to identify fully generated recordings without human performance. Its exclusion of such recordings from royalties is an institutional policy account; the contract, accuracy, deployment and individual decisions remain unverified. Daily platform figures of 60,000 tracks and 39%, and claims of technical superiority, come from interested parties, not local sampling or independent audit. They do not show that detection caused overall royalty growth. The AI-assisted bilingual abstract awaits human review; Hungarian titles and original links are retained without full-text or media copies.

description.en: On 30 September 2026, IMPF and IMPEL proposed principles for generative-AI music licensing. They distinguish payments for past uses, training, generated outputs and future exploitation, and call for rightsholder involvement in scope and valuation. This is an industry negotiating framework, not a concluded collective licence or a statutory tariff.
description.original: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI 音乐授权原则，要求区分对既往使用、训练、生成输出及未来利用的支付，并让权利人参与决定授权范围与价值。这是行业组织提出的谈判框架，不是已签订的统一许可协议或法定收费标准。
description.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI 音乐授权原则，要求区分对既往使用、训练、生成输出及未来利用的支付，并让权利人参与决定授权范围与价值。这是行业组织提出的谈判框架，不是已签订的统一许可协议或法定收费标准。
material_description.en: The statement argues that compositions should be valued at least equally to recordings absent other salient factors. Licences should specify uses; limited pilots should not establish broad precedents; deductions, valuation and reporting should be transparent. The organisations also report three attribution-technology pilots, without establishing independently verified attribution accuracy. Both pages of the official joint statement were read. description.en: In case 25-2153, the Third Circuit affirmed the copyright and fair-use ruling concerning 2,243 Westlaw headnotes. The opinion records a filing date of 29 September 2026; the court’s public list records the case on 30 September. The dispute concerns protected summaries used for a competing legal-search system. The ROSS system at issue was not generative AI.

material_description.en: The court found limited transformativeness in the competing use and assessed substitution and record evidence of a training-licensing market. The absence of prior licences to other companies did not automatically eliminate a potential market. This reasoning depends on the products, material and evidence in this case; it is not a blanket ruling that all generative-model training infringes copyright. Reading scope: introduction, system description, the first and fourth fair-use factors, and conclusion of the 32-page opinion; not the complete litigation record. description.en: Section 15 of Public Act 26-15 takes effect on 1 October 2026. It imposes provenance duties on covered providers of generative-AI systems with over one million monthly users that are publicly accessible for personal use by Connecticut consumers. It concerns generated or materially altered audio, images and video, subject to commercial and technical reasonableness.

The section lists exemptions for business-to-business uses, products solely providing video-game or interactive experiences, and systems solely used for upscaling, denoising or compression. Enforcement is exclusively by the Attorney General; this section creates no private right of action. Reading scope: Section 15 on pages 27–29 as exposed by the official enacted-text index. description.en: SB 8 / Chapter 445, approved on 12 May 2026, takes effect on 1 October and amends Criminal Law §8-301. It brings specified AI and deepfake conduct within identity-fraud rules. The relevant prohibition requires knowing, wilful conduct and fraudulent intent, addressing harmful impersonation and specified false-record practices rather than generally banning AI art or stylistic imitation.
description.original: 2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1 日生效，修订《刑法》第 8-301 条，将特定 AI 和深度伪造行为纳入身份欺诈规制。相关禁止要求明知、故意和欺诈意图，并针对冒用身份造成伤害及特定虚假记录行为，不是对 AI 艺术或风格模仿的一般禁令。
description.zh: 2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1 日生效，修订《刑法》第 8-301 条，将特定 AI 和深度伪造行为纳入身份欺诈规制。相关禁止要求明知、故意和欺诈意图，并针对冒用身份造成伤害及特定虚假记录行为，不是对 AI 艺术或风格模仿的一般禁令。
material_description.en: The revised official fiscal and policy note explains harmful impersonation, false depiction or claimed representation, and creation or distribution of false records for specified purposes. Victims of the relevant prohibited conduct may seek an injunction or other appropriate relief. Listed forms such as drawings, cartoons, sculptures and paintings are excluded from the deepfake definition; this is not a blanket artistic exemption from every AI-related offence. Read the enacted chapter’s title, definitions, prohibition and remedy passages, and final effective-date provision. Page 3 of the revised official fiscal and policy note cross-checks the ambiguous amended wording. Visual verification of PDF strike-through remains pending; this summary does not quote deleted wording. 12 May is approval; 1 October is effectiveness and catalogue entry. AI-assisted translation; independent human review pending.
material_description.original: 官方修订版财政与政策说明明确，相关条款涉及通过冒充、虚假描绘或声称代表某人造成伤害，以及出于法定目的制作或传播虚假记录；受害人可就相关禁止行为请求禁令或其他适当救济。“深度伪造”的定义排除绘画、漫画、雕塑等列明形式，但这并不是对一切 AI 相关违法行为的全面艺术豁免。 核读官方颁布文本的标题、定义、禁止行为与救济段落、末页生效日，并以官方修订版财政与政策说明第 3 页核对易混淆的修订措辞。PDF 删除线版面仍待视觉复核；本摘要不引用被删除的旧措辞。5 月 12 日为批准日，10 月 1 日为生效及本次入库日。AI 辅助翻译，独立人工审校待完成。
